correctness.rationale: For every base a=-1 mod3 the exact cube factorization yields v3(U_n)=v3(n) and U_n/n=(-1)^(n-1) mod3. In every prefix the top ternary layer consists of one or two indices t*3^r; their hth inverse units equal 1 and all remaining summands vanish after normalization. Thus the normalized sum is d in {1,2}, proving both assertions. The proof covers N=1 and h arbitrary. Standalone independent checker passed 1750 rational and 1024 modular cases; those are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Natural exact three-adic denominator growth and first ternary unit of every finite reciprocal-power prefix, simultaneously across infinitely many Lucas bases, arbitrary exponents and indices. This gives a complete index classification, reveals no cancellation at the highest prime-power layer, and sharp jump locations. The arithmetic invariant is distinct from and not determined by real infinite-tail estimates; the structural unit lemma and all-parameter law exceed a fixed finite computation.
